title: Antifungal ↔ Neurotoxin Coupled Dataset
hypothesis: Compounds/events that are both antifungal and neurotoxic reveal shared membrane targets between Kingdom Fungi and nervous tissue. The intersection is a natural experiment — and a new membrane dataset.
why_new: We named fungi from fruit (visible feeds/papers). Taxonomy may be WAY OFF. Shared antifungal–neurotoxin pharmacology is independent evidence that fungal and neural membranes couple — so membrane 'fungi' and CNS/PNS share measurable toxicity space.

schema.fungal_target: sterol | cell_wall | nucleic_acid | membrane_pore | mito | other
schema.neural_target: cyp | ion_channel | mito | myelin | bbb_cross | circadian | other
